### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **127** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **6** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts`, `packages/lint/src/index.ts`, `packages/lint/src/validate-translatable-sections.ts`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**44** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0e4dfbe27a2a312864cd8d14e4954b6af14e2a22`.

⛔ **14** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **6** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts`, `packages/lint/src/index.ts`, `packages/lint/src/validate-translatable-sections.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `objectName (symbol, 56 pages)`, `objectName (literal, 56 pages)`
- **7** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **179** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0e4dfbe27a2a312864cd8d14e4954b6af14e2a22` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `140f246573e91c9feea13b8d11db7bb16514daac` — the merge of head `6950aec746cb42060cbcb2d1940648b53a42c9a4` into base `0e4dfbe27a2a312864cd8d14e4954b6af14e2a22`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 140f246573e91c9feea13b8d11db7bb16514daac && git checkout 140f246573e91c9feea13b8d11db7bb16514daac
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0e4dfbe27a2a312864cd8d14e4954b6af14e2a22 6950aec746cb42060cbcb2d1940648b53a42c9a4 && git checkout -B drift-repro 0e4dfbe27a2a312864cd8d14e4954b6af14e2a22 && git merge --no-ff 6950aec746cb42060cbcb2d1940648b53a42c9a4

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0e4dfbe27a2a312864cd8d14e4954b6af14e2a22
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 0e4dfbe27a2a312864cd8d14e4954b6af14e2a22` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读（席位终稿）

- **改了什么**：把「一个应用有哪些可翻译的键、各自原文是什么」的遍历 `collectExpectedEntries` 原样从 CLI 挪进 `@objectstack/lint`；CLI 保留打包与写文件部分，并再导出原来的 12 个名字。不改任何键、骨架或覆盖率结论。
- **为什么改**：#30285 要在 Studio 里做「原文 / 译文」对照表，浏览器必须跑同一套遍历，而 CLI 是 Node 包。
- **风险与回滚**：低。纯搬移，席位逐行对过：搬出的 618 行与新 CLI 文件只差头部注释和 import 两行。PR 计 +879 / −682 = 1561 行。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`（由 `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` 改名而来）与 `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-bundle-extract.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/i18n-bundle-extract-exports.pin.test.ts test/i18n-walk-output-parity.test.ts`。
- **需要你做的**：无。不是受管面，也未过 3000 行线，席位直接落地。
- **席位意见**：ACCEPT。之前说要人工合并是席位读错了行数（用了 `--branch` 的 `--no-renames` 预估），按 `--pr` 读数改正，正文同步更正。

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · head `6950aec7` · 2026-11-05T10:53Z

1. **Shape:** draft, base `main`, `Part of #30285` (PR-B, the Studio table, follows), no other issue number in the body. 60 files, +879/−682. `check-governed-merges --pr 30375`: 0 of 61 paths governed; size 1561 ≤ 3000, read from the PR object as the queue guard reads it. Ordinary queue landing. The body's earlier "human merge" lines came from the `--branch` forecast, which counts with `--no-renames` (6567); corrected in the body in this stroke.
2. **Read by the seat:** the rename `cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts → lint/src/i18n-walk.ts` adds 17 lines (header prose; `authorWarnedProperties` / `walkPageComponents` now imported relatively from `./lint-liveness-properties.js` / `./page-walk.js`) and removes 618. Those 618 lines, compared with the new `cli/src/utils/i18n-bundle-extract.ts` (631), differ only in header prose and the `@objectstack/lint` import / re-export lines: the code moved as is. lint's new imports are all `@objectstack/spec/*` subpaths it already depends on. The 44 importer edits are one-line path repoints; `lint/src/index.ts` adds the five public names. The liveness ledgers change cites only (4). `packages/lint` is `private: false`: the changeset names lint, cli and spec (spec for the ledger cites), and its prose matches the diff.
3. **Accepted deviations:** stale prose cites of the old path left in eight files outside the move's packages (listed in the body); a follow-up gap noted in the body: `check:i18n` / `check:i18n-coverage` derive from `packages/cli/src/**` only, so a later lint-only edit to the walk does not derive them locally (CI still runs them).
4. **Evidence:** check-runs on `6950aec7`: 55 success, 9 skipped; `check-expected-skips --pr 30375` OK (all 9 in main's roster). Dev's local battery: lint + cli unit and typecheck exit 0, `dispatch-gates` 87/87 exit 0 with `--ran` clean. No `merge=os-regen` path touched. `mergeable_state: clean`.
5. **Out of scope:** the derivation gap above goes with PR-B's card thread to name or file; `Skills-docs:` n/a (refactor, no authoring change).
